| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Brightness threshold** `threshold` | 20 | 1 to 100 levels | The brightness threshold t. Neighbors that differ by much more than t barely count. It should be above the noise and below the contrast of the edges to keep. 20 is our choice. |
| **Spatial sigma** `sigma` | 2 | 0.5 to 5 px | The sigma of the spatial Gaussian. The window reaches ceil(2 sigma) pixels in each direction, our choice. 2 is our choice. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
